```lean
theorem lg_target {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < τ.im) (n : ℤ) : ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs := by
  intro n
  have h1 : 0 < Real.pi * τ.im := mul_pos (zero_lt_real_pi) hτ
  let a := ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ
  have h2 : 0 < Real.re a := by
    simp only [Real.pi, Complex.I, Complex.re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Real.ofReal, Real.mul]
    exact mul_pos (zero_lt_real_pi) hτ
  have h3 : Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs = Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im * n.natAbs) :=
    by rw [Real.pow_exp, Real.mul_assoc, Real.pow_mul, Real.exp_mul]
  have h4 : ‖Complex.exp a‖ = Real.exp (Real.re a) :=
    by rw [Complex.nnnorm_eq_real_exp_re]
  have h5 : Real.re a = Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2 :=
    by simp only [Real.pi, Complex.I, Complex.re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Real.ofReal, Real.mul]
  have h6 : Real.exp (Real.re a) = Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2) :=
    by rw h5
  have h7 : Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2 ≤ Real.pi * τ.im * n.natAbs :=
    by rw [Real.mul_le_mul_left (Real.ofNat_nonneg _), Real.le_abs]
    exact le_rfl
  have h8 : Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im * n.natAbs) :=
    by rw [h3, Real.exp_le_exp]; exact h7
  have h9 : ‖Complex.exp a‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs :=
    by rw [h4, h6, h8]
  exact h9
```
